# Imported local changes

These patches document changes that had been developed against the npm-installed extension packages before the source was vendored.

Their results are already incorporated into the files under `vendor/`; they are retained only as provenance and are not applied during installation.

- `pi-subagents-ui.patch` → `vendor/pi-subagents/`
- `pi-claudify-footer.patch` → `vendor/@owlburtoe/pi-claudify/`
- `rpiv-todo-guidance.patch` → `vendor/@juicesharp/rpiv-todo/`
